title: Double Buffering Pipeline
description: Two buffer boxes swapping between capture and processing roles each cycle, with a timeline strip showing that exactly one buffer is capturing at every instant.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
Real-Time Systems
Embedded Systems

educational.topic: Double buffering in a real-time pipeline
learningObjectives: Interpret how two buffers alternate roles
Explain why capture never has to pause
State the timing constraint double buffering does not remove

controls.label: Advance one cycle
controls.purpose: Swap the two buffers' roles and extend the timeline

equations: Buffer A captures when cycle is even
assumptions: Processing always completes within one capture period
limitations: Does not model the overrun case where processing exceeds one capture period, though the documentation raises it

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Steppable mechanism with a checkable invariant
keyQuestions: Is any column of the timeline without a capturing buffer?
What must be true about FFT time for this to work?
commonMisconceptions: That one buffer is permanently the capture buffer
That double buffering removes all timing constraints
assessmentOpportunities: Judge whether double buffering rescues a 40 ms pipeline with a 32 ms capture period
